en: Black‑and‑white image of an ornate Baroque Catholic church interior, focused on the main altar. The altar is richly decorated with carved columns, statues of saints, candles, and framed images. Above and around the altar are painted arches and foliage-like decorations. In front of the altar rail a cloth banner bears a German Marian greeting. Wooden pews and decorative metal railings are visible in the foreground.
